name: Where They Wait
source:
"Never enter the forest on Beltane Eve, for the veil between Us and Them is thin."

You race to the edge of the forest as Beltane approaches. Whispers beckon to you, and you know: They are watching you. Your lungs burn, and you're sure your legs will give out at any moment. 

And yet, you run. 

Not away from Them, but towards Them. 

Will you find what you seek tonight?

They lurk in the darkness. Snakes that wear human skin, with sharpened eyes that see fear and forked tongues that speak in temptation. Scavengers that feast without remorse, seeking any call desperate enough to beg for a demon's help.

[From [url=https://crescence-studio.itch.io/where-they-wait]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
“永远不要在贝尔坦之夜进入森林，因为我们和他们之间的面纱很薄。”

当贝尔塔尼接近时，你跑到了森林边缘。耳语在向你招手，你知道：他们正在看着你。你的肺部在燃烧，你确信你的双腿随时都会瘫痪。

然而，你还是跑了。

不是远离他们，而是走向他们。

今晚你能找到你想要的东西吗？

他们潜伏在黑暗中。蛇披着人皮，目光锐利，能看到恐惧，分叉的舌头能发出诱惑。食腐者毫无悔意地享受盛宴，寻求任何绝望的呼唤来乞求恶魔的帮助。

[来自[url=https://crescence-studio.itch.io/where-they-wait]itch.io[/url]]
